purpose: Record local source-context review for all 24 C2-LT-B3 source extraction rows. This register verifies structural readiness for independent fresh review while preserving source-resolution issues, blocked uses, reviewed-artifact blocks and model-admission blocks.

scope.selectionRule: Review every C2-LT-B3 source extraction row after field extraction and before independent fresh review, card promotion or any model-admission consideration.
currentLimitations: This is a local structural and source-context review, not independent fresh review.
Rows with PubMed mismatches, title/part mismatches or publisher access blocks require source-resolution or manual access before they can support domain claims.
Rows can move to independent fresh review or source-resolution review, but they cannot move to Source Card promotion or reviewed artifacts until fresh-review verdicts exist.
No row admits calibrated prediction, individual advice, individual death-date output, intervention ranking, clinical-validity claim or domain-claim upgrade.

localReviewChecks: Every reviewed task is present in the C2-LT-B3 source extraction queue.
Every reviewed task has a completed extraction row in the C2-LT-B3 source extraction register.
Every extraction row preserves exact claim use, endpoint, population or setting, mechanism or effect, uncertainty, transfer boundary, downgrade triggers and model position.
Every extraction row keeps model admission blocked and prohibited uses complete.
Every local domain path exists and exposes README.md and AGENTS.md.
Rows with source-lineage, title/part or publisher-access issues are explicitly preserved in sourceResolutionFindings.
The register routes the batch to independent fresh review and source-resolution review before Source Card promotion.

nonClaims: This register is not an independent fresh review verdict register.
This register does not complete any reviewed Source Card, variable card, endpoint card, uncertainty card, transfer-boundary card or downgrade-check artifact.
This register does not repair source-lineage mismatches; it records them for source-resolution review.
This register does not validate external source truth, clinical recommendations, intervention effects, calibrated risks or individual prognosis.
This register does not authorize model admission, domain-claim upgrade, intervention ranking, individual advice or individual death-date output.
